issues.issue: Whether the post-rejection evidence (declarations, photos, articles) is admissible
issues.applicant_position: Submits statutory declarations, photos and two articles from after the rejection as new evidence.
issues.result_text: New documents meet admissibility under s.110(4) and Rule 29 and will be considered.

issues.issue: Whether the GALCK membership card, letter and police and hospital records are genuine
issues.applicant_position: Stamped documents could be genuine; forensic examination is required before finding fraud.
issues.result_text: Stamp irregularities are apparent on their face; forensic examination not required; documents found fraudulent.

issues.issue: Whether inconsistent testimony on who she told about her orientation, and on partner letters, undermines credibility
issues.result_text: Conflicting testimony on who knew of her orientation and on partner letters undermines credibility; no stereotyping.

issues.issue: Whether the other evidence (photos, letters, affidavits, mother's evidence, articles) establishes sexual orientation
issues.applicant_position: Photos show more than friendship; affidavits refer to her as a lesbian.
issues.result_text: None of this evidence resolves credibility concerns or establishes her sexual orientation on balance.

issues.issue: Whether the appellant faces a serious risk of persecution as a lesbian in Kenya
issues.applicant_position: Alleges fear of persecution as a lesbian in Kenya.
issues.result_text: Sexual orientation not established, so no serious possibility of persecution, torture or cruel treatment.
